metadata.case_name: WONG KWOK MING v. CHEUNG KI CHEUNG

plaintiff.occupation_after: Investigator (Information Technology); Commission Against Corruption Officer (Middle/Lower) (ICAC)

injuries.description: Partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) of the left knee
source: a partial tear of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) of the left knee was diagnosed.
I find that the plaintiff did suffer the ACL injury complained of as a result of the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of anterior cruciate ligament of knee, excluding rupture

source: The plaintiff had sustained no more than a simple contusion to his chest in the accident.
yellowish bruising and diffused anterior chest wall tenderness

injuries.description: Degenerative cervical spine / deteriorated cervical spondylosis (pre-existing)
source: pre-existing history of neck pain for some 2 years prior to the injury
radiological examination revealed multiple levels of degeneration of the cervical spine
the deteriorated cervical spondylosis was a separate pre-existing complaint not in any way precipitated or worsened by the accident.

manifestations.description: yellowish bruising and diffused anterior chest wall tenderness
decreased range of left knee movement
tenderness over the patella of the left side
bruising and tenderness over the anterior and lateral aspect of left knee
unstable knee with a sense of instability when performing activities such as running, jumping and climbing
apprehension / inability or difficulty in satisfactorily completing the Annual Fitness Test (AFT)
neck pain / cervical radiculopathy (diagnosed later) but regarded as pre-existing and not caused by the accident

losses.description: Moderate degree of ACL laxity translating to 17% impairment of the lower limb or 7% impairment of the whole person; instability and reduced stability of the injured left knee.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: To prevent further injury to the unstable knee, vigorous activities like sprinting, soccer, basketball and jumping should be avoided.

comparable_cases.case_name: Liu Hung Fai v Sandvik HongKong Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: 69 year old female victim; temporary loss of consciousness, underwent operations on her left knee, convalesced for 5 months in an infirmary; lengthy course of physiotherapy; at trial still suffered knee pain, walked with a limp and required the aid of a walking stick; inability to squat down or climb height; muscle wasting in the injured limb; prevented from pursuing pre-accident vocation.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Yeuk Yiu v Chan Ho Kwan
comparable_cases.injury_description: Plaintiff sustained head, right wrist and right knee injuries with fracture to his distal radius of the right wrist and laceration to his antero-lateral knee joint of the right leg; hospitalized about 10 days; underwent debridement, irrigation and sutures to knee and close reduction and short arm plaster for right wrist; head and wrist recovered but reduced mobility in the right knee remained.
